title: A reviewed publication summary: what git says of evidence kept in the private archive
description: One small file per summary under llm-dlc/artifacts/YYYY/MM/DD/. It describes evidence and how to verify it; a checker's verdict still comes from its own validator. Unbounded rows, paths, tool text and case lists stay in digest-addressed objects of the private archive, which `archive` names. At most 64 KiB (256 KiB for a catalog page, catalog-*.json): sync.py checkpoint refuses a larger one. Never a credential, a signed or expiring URL, a literal finding or a sensitive file name.

kind.description: promotion, job, selector-set, trace-segment, or any other name: an unknown kind carries the common fields alone

id.description: the promotion's id, or the occurrence id of what is summarized

source.description: safe source references: commits, trees, change ids, a job id, counts

archive.description: where the full evidence is: an occurrence id and the SHA-256 and length of its original bytes; never a URL that expires

policy.description: the versions of the rules the summary was made under

first_blocker.description: only if it may be published

url.description: the public URL, only once the CDN's copy is verified
